## Load data

```{r}
zotu97 <- import_qiime("../01_Raw_data/p1031_run231218_Revio_16S_ZOTU_c97_Count_Sintax.txt")

metadata <- read.csv("../01_Raw_data/metadata_2025.csv" ) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var= "sample_name")
metadata$treat.pot <- paste(metadata$treatment, metadata$rep, sep= "_")

zotu97 <- merge_phyloseq(zotu97, sample_data(metadata))


taxonomy_16S_dada2 <- readRDS("../01_Raw_data/dada2_taxonomy/taxonomy_16S_dada2.RDa")

tax_table(zotu97) <- tax_table(taxonomy_16S_dada2)
```

## Data Filtering

```{r}
## Remove those taxa that have less than 3 reads in 3 samples
cleaning.function <- function(x) { x >  3}
keep_taxa <- genefilter_sample(zotu97, cleaning.function, A = 3)
zotu97<- prune_taxa(keep_taxa, zotu97)
otu.table <- zotu97%>% otu_table() %>% data.frame()
nrow(otu.table) 

## Filter to remove < 0.01% 
phy.rel <- transform_sample_counts(zotu97, function(x) x / sum(x))

otus_to_keep <- taxa_names(phy.rel)[
  apply(otu_table(phy.rel), 1, mean) >= 0.0001]

zotu97 <- prune_taxa(otus_to_keep, zotu97)

```

# Differential Abundance Analysis

```{r}
set.seed(5070)
```

## DESeq2

```{r}
phy.chicken <- subset_samples(zotu97, treatment%in%c("control", "chicken"))
phy.cow <- subset_samples(zotu97, treatment%in% c("control", "cow"))
phy.pellet <- subset_samples(zotu97, treatment%in%c("control", "pellet"))
phy.compost <- subset_samples(zotu97, treatment%in%c("control", "compost"))
```

### Chicken

```{r deseq chicken}
dds_chicken <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = data.frame(otu_table(phy.chicken, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)),
                                      colData = data.frame(sample_data(phy.chicken)),
                                      design= ~treatment+time)
# control is the reference level, so the coefficient is "treatment_chicken_vs_control"
dds_chicken$treatment <- relevel(factor(dds_chicken$treatment), ref = "control")
dds_chicken <- DESeq(dds_chicken)

res_chicken <- results(dds_chicken, contrast = c("treatment", "chicken", "control"))
res_chicken<- lfcShrink(
  dds_chicken,
  coef = "treatment_chicken_vs_control",
  type = "apeglm") %>% data.frame()%>% rownames_to_column(var= "OTU")

# Save the shrunken DESeq2 results (same idea as the ANCOM-BC2 chunks below)
# Sign: the coefficient is "chicken vs control", so a POSITIVE log2FoldChange = enriched in CHICKEN.
res_chicken$treatment <- "chicken"
attr(res_chicken, "lfc_direction") <- "amendment_vs_control"   # tag read by 04b_DAA_16S_merged_dotplot.R
saveRDS(res_chicken, file = "../03_Analysis_files/deseq_chicken_bact.RDa")
```

### Shape the data

```{r deseq bind}

res_chicken$treatment <- "chicken"
res_compost$treatment <- "compost"
res_cow$treatment <- "cow"
res_pellet$treatment <- "pellet"

res_all_bact_deseq <- rbind(res_chicken, res_compost, res_cow, res_pellet) 
threshold_deseq <- quantile(abs(res_all_bact_deseq$log2FoldChange), 0.975, na.rm= TRUE) %>% as.numeric() 



res_all_bact_deseq <- res_all_bact_deseq %>% mutate(selected=ifelse(padj<0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange)>threshold_deseq, res_all_bact_deseq$treatment, "no")) %>% na.omit()
number_selected_deseq <-nrow(filter(res_all_bact_deseq, res_all_bact_deseq$selected!= "no"))
```

### Volcano Plot

```{r deseq volcano}
volcano_plot_deseq <- res_all_bact_deseq %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), col= selected, )) +
  geom_point(size= 3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1*(as.numeric(threshold_deseq)), as.numeric(threshold_deseq)), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  theme_classic()+
  # # facet_wrap(~treatment, scales= "free", labeller = labeller(
  #    treatment = c(
  #      "chicken"     = "Chicken manure",
  #      "cow"         = "Cow manure",
  #      "compost"     = "Compost",
  #      "pellet"      = "Pelletised compost"
  #    )), strip.position= "top")+
  theme(strip.placement = "outside")+
  scale_color_manual(values= treat.colors, breaks = treat.order, labels= treat.labels )+
  labs(title= paste("DESeq2"), y = expression(-log[10]*"(padj)"),
       subtitle = paste("Positive values are enriched in the treatment compared to the control.\n", 
                        number_selected_deseq, "OTUs are above the set thresholds"))+
  guides(color=guide_legend("Treatment"))+
  facet_wrap(~treatment,nrow= 1, ncol = 4, 
             labeller= as_labeller(c("chicken"= "Chicken", 
                                     "compost"= "Compost",
                                     "cow"=  "Cow",
                                     "pellet"="Pellet")))

volcano_plot_deseq

ggsave(volcano_plot_deseq, file= "../04_Figures/FigureX_16S.png", width= 1900,height= 1200, units= "px")


saveRDS(volcano_plot_deseq, file = '../03_Analysis_files/FigureX_16S.RDa')
```

## ANCOMBC

### Chicken

```{r ancombc chicken}
phy.chicken <- subset_samples(zotu97, treatment %in% c("control", "chicken"))

ancombc2_chicken <- ancombc2(
  data = phy.chicken,
  fix_formula = "treatment + time",
  rand_formula = "(1 | treat.pot)",
  p_adj_method = "BH",
   n_cl = parallel::detectCores() - 1
  )

ancombc2_chicken <- ancombc2_chicken$res
ancombc2_chicken <- data.frame(
  taxon = ancombc2_chicken$taxon,
  # the fit gives "control vs chicken" (reference level = chicken): reverse it so that
  # POSITIVE = enriched in CHICKEN. SE and p-values do not depend on the direction.
  lfc = -ancombc2_chicken$lfc_treatmentcontrol,
  se = ancombc2_chicken$se_treatmentcontrol,
  p_val = ancombc2_chicken$p_treatmentcontrol,
  p_adj = ancombc2_chicken$q_treatmentcontrol)
ancombc2_chicken$treatment <- "chicken"
attr(ancombc2_chicken, "lfc_direction") <- "amendment_vs_control"   # tag read by 04b_DAA_16S_merged_dotplot.R
saveRDS(ancombc2_chicken, file= "../03_Analysis_files/ancombc_chicken_bact.RDa")
```

```{r ancomb pellet}
pellet<-readRDS("../03_Analysis_files/ancombc_pellet_bact.RDa")
cow<-readRDS("../03_Analysis_files/ancombc_cow_bact.RDa")
compost<-readRDS("../03_Analysis_files/ancombc_compost_bact.RDa")
```

```{r ancombc fix direction}
# ONE-OFF, NO REFIT NEEDED. The ANCOM-BC2 files saved before the fix hold, for
# chicken and compost, the contrast "control vs amendment" (reversed). Here the
# sign of `lfc` is reversed for those two (SE and p-values are unchanged) and all
# four files get the tag "amendment_vs_control". Files that already carry the tag
# are left alone, so this chunk is safe to run more than once.
for (n in c("chicken", "cow", "compost", "pellet")) {
  f <- sprintf("../03_Analysis_files/ancombc_%s_bact.RDa", n)
  x <- readRDS(f)
  if (!identical(attr(x, "lfc_direction"), "amendment_vs_control")) {
    if (n %in% c("chicken", "compost")) x$lfc <- -x$lfc
    attr(x, "lfc_direction") <- "amendment_vs_control"
    saveRDS(x, file = f)
  }
}

pellet  <- readRDS("../03_Analysis_files/ancombc_pellet_bact.RDa")
cow     <- readRDS("../03_Analysis_files/ancombc_cow_bact.RDa")
compost <- readRDS("../03_Analysis_files/ancombc_compost_bact.RDa")
chicken <- readRDS("../03_Analysis_files/ancombc_chicken_bact.RDa")
```


```{r ancombc bind}


res_all_bact_ancombc <- rbind(chicken, compost, cow, pellet) 

threshold_ancombc<- quantile(abs(res_all_bact_ancombc$lfc), 0.975, na.rm= TRUE) %>% as.numeric() 
res_all_bact_ancombc <- res_all_bact_ancombc %>% 
  mutate(selected=ifelse(p_adj<0.05 & abs(lfc)>threshold_ancombc,
                         res_all_bact_ancombc$treatment, "no")) %>%
  na.omit()
res_all_bact_ancombc$OTU <- res_all_bact_ancombc$taxon

number_selected_ancombc <- sum(res_all_bact_ancombc$selected!= "no")

```
